items.label: f01-layer-responsibilities
items.front: Which layer owns what in the ww27 profile API?
items.back: Adapter: translate version names/statuses into one canonical model. Service: ownership, role, lifecycle and no-op policy (so direct callers get the same protections). Repository: session read scope. Audit metadata: after a successful repository operation.

items.label: f03-unknown-version-is-routing-error
items.front: Why must an unknown API version fail rather than fall back?
items.back: It is a routing error, not a request to serve silently with defaults. Explicit errors are easier to monitor and safer for clients; route params and JSON are untrusted strings even when the parameter is typed ApiVersionId, so check at runtime before any write.

items.label: f04-fakes-are-not-atomicity
items.front: What do fake repositories prove about profile + audit persistence?
items.back: Call ordering only, not cross-connection atomicity. The profile and audit writes are sequential; document that limit and require a transaction-capable repository before claiming stronger guarantees.

items.label: f02-presence-contract
items.front: Presence is a data contract: omitted vs false vs empty
items.back: Omitted means leave the stored value alone; false, zero or an empty array are deliberate values. Validation rejects only what the contract declares invalid, and the adapter never invents values for omitted fields, so patches are assembled field by field.
